cases.question: average speed per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: how many readings per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS readings FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: what was the highest wave height
cases.sql: SELECT MAX(wave_height) AS max_wave_height FROM telemetry

cases.question: average water temperature across the fleet
cases.sql: SELECT avg(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp FROM telemetry

cases.question: minimum and maximum speed for each vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MIN(speed) AS min_speed, MAX(speed) AS max_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour_bucket, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '2 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: max wave height per vessel per day
cases.sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', ts) AS day, vessel, max(wave_height) AS max_wave FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: daily minimum and maximum water temperature
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, MIN(water_temp) AS min_water_temp, MAX(water_temp) AS max_water_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Aurora's average speed in 15-minute buckets over the last day
cases.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '15 minutes', ts) AS bucket, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: average wind per vessel in six-hour buckets
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '6 hours', ts) AS bucket, vessel, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY bucket, vessel

cases.question: average speed by hour of day
cases.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM ts) AS hour_of_day, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY hour_of_day

cases.question: average wave height by day of the week
cases.sql: SELECT dayname(ts) AS day, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

cases.question: speed of Atlas every 10 minutes today
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '10 minutes', ts) AS t, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Atlas' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: water temperature trend for Aurora in the last week
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour_ts, avg(water_temp) AS avg_water_temp FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: which vessel was fastest on average in the last 24 hours
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: compare wave height of all vessels by hour over the last 12 hours
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hr, vessel, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '12 hours' GROUP BY hr, vessel ORDER BY hr, vessel

cases.question: mean speed for the last 30 minutes in one-minute buckets
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS bucket, AVG(speed) AS mean_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '30 minutes' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

cases.question: Average wind from September 3 to September 5, 2026, hourly
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour_bucket, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-03 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-06 00:00:00' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: Average wave height for the last hour in one-minute buckets
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 minute', ts) AS minute_bucket, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 hour' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hr, vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel IN ('Kestrel','Nomad') GROUP BY hr, vessel ORDER BY hr, vessel

cases.question: Compare vessel speed by hour over the last day excluding Aurora
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hr, vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel <> 'Aurora' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1, 2

cases.question: how many readings had waves above 4 metres, per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS readings_over_4m FROM telemetry WHERE wave_height > 4 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Hourly average speed for vessels north of latitude 50 in the last day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hr, vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY hr, vessel ORDER BY hr, vessel

cases.question: Show hourly wind for Poseidon over the last 7 days
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour_bucket, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Poseidon' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY hour_bucket ORDER BY hour_bucket

cases.question: in how many hours did Solstice see wind above 30 knots
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts)) AS hours_above_30 FROM telemetry WHERE vessel = 'Solstice' AND wind > 30

cases.question: table of the 10 highest hourly average wave heights
cases.reason: right rows in the wrong order
cases.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT h,avg_wave FROM (SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour',ts) AS h,avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave FROM telemetry GROUP BY h ORDER BY avg_wave DESC LIMIT 10) ORDER BY h

cases.question: the three fastest vessels by average speed in the past 7 days
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY avg_speed DESC LIMIT 3

cases.question: which day had the strongest average wind
cases.sql: SELECT CAST(ts AS DATE) AS day, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY day ORDER BY avg_wind DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel recorded the coldest water
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MIN(water_temp) AS min_water_temp FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY min_water_temp ASC LIMIT 1

cases.question: which vessel got farthest east
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MAX(lon) AS max_lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY max_lon DESC LIMIT 1

cases.question: correlation between wind and speed per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, corr(wind, speed) AS wind_speed_corr FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: difference between maximum and minimum water temperature per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, MAX(water_temp) - MIN(water_temp) AS temp_range FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Compare speed and wave height by hour over the last 7 days
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hr, avg(speed) AS avg_speed, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr

cases.question: Average ratio of wave height to wind speed per hour over the last day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hr, avg(wave_height/wind) AS wave_wind_ratio FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr

cases.question: average speed of each vessel in km/h over the last day
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(speed)*1.852 AS avg_kmh FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '1 day' GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: average speed per vessel in the first week versus the second week
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, CASE WHEN ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-08 00:00:00' THEN 'first week' ELSE 'second week' END AS week, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel, week ORDER BY vessel, week

cases.question: latest position of every vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, arg_max(lat, ts) AS lat, arg_max(lon, ts) AS lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: where was Meridian yesterday
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hr, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Meridian' AND ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-13 00:00:00' AND ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 00:00:00' GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr

cases.question: show all vessel tracks on a map
cases.sql:
-- view: tracks
SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS ts, vessel, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ts, vessel

cases.question: how many readings were taken north of 50 degrees latitude, per vessel
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, COUNT(*) AS readings FROM telemetry WHERE lat > 50 GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: Aurora's average position per day
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 day', ts) AS day, avg(lat) AS lat, avg(lon) AS lon FROM telemetry WHERE vessel='Aurora' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

cases.question: average wave height per ves
cases.sql: SELECT vessel, AVG(wave_height) AS avg_wave_height FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

cases.question: wind
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour, vessel, avg(wind) AS avg_wind FROM telemetry GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

cases.question: speed last week
cases.sql: SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', ts) AS hour_bucket, vessel, avg(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= TIMESTAMP '2026-09-14 23:59:54' - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY hour_bucket, vessel ORDER BY hour_bucket, vessel

cases.question: scatter of wind vs wave height
cases.sql:
-- view: scatter
SELECT round(wind, 1) AS wind_kn, avg(wave_height) AS avg_wave_m FROM telemetry GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
